Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single thread for the load test coordination: 

1) Target SLOs (as discussed):
   - P95 latency (streaming): <= 350ms per token
   - P99 latency (batch non-streaming): <= 800ms per request (avg payload 512 tokens)
   - Throughput: sustained 400 rps for text-generation endpoints
   - Concurrency: up to 120 concurrent connections (streaming enabled)

2) Load test approach: customer-led test using k6 (you mentioned an existing harness). We agreed FinWise will run tests from your infra and we'll provide a Redwood test account + IP allowlist and a sample k6 script.

3) Test window: you suggested a 3-hour window next Tue (6/23) morning PST. Please confirm final window so we can provision dedicated capacity.

4) Deliverables from Redwood:
   - Temporary test API key and dedicated test model endpoint (scope-limited)
   - IP allowlist/CIDR ranges for your test agents to hit
   - Example k6 script tuned to our streaming endpoint (attached: finwise_k6_script_v1.js)
   - Runbook & account instructions (attached PDF)

Action items: 
- Jamie / Julie: confirm the exact date/time and expected agent locations (AWS region / IP range).
- Aditya: can you provision the test account + endpoint and share allowlist CIDRs once we have the IPs?
- Rishi: please review the attached k6 and call out any changes for streaming behavior (we need to ensure chunked responses look realistic).

Thanks — planning to lock details once Jamie confirms the window.

Best,
